panels.title: alerta: Agua en el piso del cuarto técnico

targets.query:
from(bucket: "cuarto")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetria" and r._field == "agua")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["nodo"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "nodo"])

from(bucket: "cuarto")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetria" and r._field == "seq")
  |> group(columns: ["nodo"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, nodo: r.nodo, _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
